note: What build 11 was to be (build 10 plus the known-gaps round, R502-R550; GitHub gave its Mac job no runner five times, so no build 11 exists) plus two pieces, each reviewed, joined and verified together (R546-R574). FR-749: a closed library is never written into - a close lets a change that is being written finish and cancels cleanly what has written nothing: an attach, a watched folder's bringing-in, a Bulk Import (left paused), a backup (cancelled, nothing recorded), a retention destruction's backups step (finished at the next opening); nothing more is sent to a lookup service once a close begins; Quit no longer waits for an attach that waits on a lookup. Decision 31 (b): attaching a file no longer waits for a metadata service that says 'too many requests' - the file comes in at once, marked 'needs review', with the owner's words 'Waiting for lookup service response.'; Bulk Import and Zotero wait as before. The launch check's scenario Q (Quit by a system request) runs on a Mac for the first time in this build.
